title: 4 SPEED TRANS. BACK-UP LAMP SWITCH & SPEEDO CABLE ROUTING
summary: 4-speed manual transmission cars: the back-up (reverse) lamp switch mounted on the LH side of the transmission and actuated by a rod from the reverse selector lever, and the routing of the speedometer cable from the transmission to the dash. The switch and its shield screw to a bracket that is held on by the transmission side-cover bolts; the speedometer cable is held to the body by clips riveted on with blind rivets.

parts.name: SPRING
parts.name_expanded: Spring - retainer spring for back-up switch activating rod

fastening.note: View A: two screws [5] go through shield [6] and switch [3] into bracket [2]; left loose until the switch lever is pinned to the bracket with the .090 in gage pin, then torqued.
View A: bracket [2] is held by existing transmission cover bolts (labelled COVER BOLT, no callout).

fastening.to: back-up switch [3] lever and transmission reverse lever
fastening.note: Activating rod [4] ends are retained by spring [1]: one at the switch lever, one at the reverse selector lever.

fastening.to: body (underbody/tunnel and floor near the dash)
fastening.note: Each speedometer cable clip [7] is riveted with a rivet [8] into a 5/32 +/- 1/64 dia hole; three clip/rivet locations shown. Hole locations see Sect. 0 sheet A10. One clip angled 45 deg.
Speedometer cable [9] runs through clips [7] and the production grommet in the dash panel; the transmission end also uses an existing speedo clip (View A).
Cable [9] upper ferrule nut torqued to 5-10 lbs in.

notes: Back-up switch procedure: 1) Put activating rod [4] on switch [3] with spring [1]; loosely mount switch [3] and shield [6] to bracket [2] with screws [5].
2) Mount the subassembly to the transmission with the cover bolts; connect rod [4] to the reverse selector lever with spring [1]. Put selector levers in neutral.
3) Pin the switch lever to the bracket with a .090 in dia. gage.
4) With the pin in, tighten screws [5] to torque.
NOTE For hole location see Sect. 0 Sheet A10.
NOTE Item [9] is to be assembled to vehicle so that "Hot Stamp" is located at grommet in dash panel.
Dimensions 4.40 and 4.50 locate the lower clip; 45° on the upper clip.
notes_internal: Item 1: hole punch covers the digits after '1481'; digit count unknown, written 1481???.
Circled (0), (1), (15) marks near the lower clip: (1) is likely the revision 1 symbol (clip location revised); (0) and (15) unclear, possibly reference lines.
Torque 2 applies to the transmission cover bolt (no callout).
Torque 3 triangle points at the cable ferrule at the dash end; which component it threads onto is not labelled.
